error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot change AI supervision. Owners, admins and instructors can.
error.SUPERVISION_CONTROL_STALE: Someone changed this learner's supervision since you opened it. Refresh and try again.
error.SUPERVISION_CONTROL_INVALID: Stopped supervision must be resumed before it can be paused.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A different change was already sent with this request. Refresh and try again.
error.SUPERVISOR_EVENT_ALREADY_REQUEUED: This request was already re-queued once. It will not be re-queued again.
error.SUPERVISOR_EVENT_NOT_QUARANTINED: This request is no longer quarantined. Refresh to see where it is.
error.SUPERVISOR_EVENT_NOT_REQUEUEABLE: This request was refused for good and cannot be re-queued.
error.SUPERVISOR_EVENT_NOT_FOUND: This request is not one of this learner's. Refresh and try again.
error.SUPERVISION_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN: The learner withdrew consent for AI supervision since this request. It was not re-queued.
error.RUBRIC_ASSIST_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN: The learner withdrew consent for review drafts since this request. It was not re-queued.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
error.unavailable: AI supervision is unavailable right now. Nothing changed.
